newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bids at Portugal bond auction seen 6.57-6.62 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bids at Portugal bond auction seen 6.57-6.62 pct.

text.p: Bids at today's auction of 20 billion escudos of three-year fixed rate Portuguese Treasury bonds should stand at between 6.57 and 6.62 percent, in line with the secondary market, dealers said.
Results of the auction are due around 1100 GMT.
"The auction will be unaggressive in terms of price, with bids between 6.57 and 6.62 percent," said a fixed rate director.
"The big question is how much the Treasury will place."

Another fixed rate director said "It is not worth being more aggressive than the secondary market level of 6.58 percent as these yields have already discounted an expected easing in Portuguese official rates."
He added: "I don't think the Treasury will allow a yield much above 6.60 percent."

At the last auction of three-year bonds on October 8, the Treasury placed 20 billion escudos of bonds at an average weighted interest rate of 6.7995 percent. The maximum offered rate was 6.80 percent and the minimum 6.77 percent.
Three-year fixed rate bonds closed yesterday on the continuous market at 10,400 escudos to yield 6.582 percent with a spread of seven basis points below April 1999 Bonos.
